name: A Reduced Cornerless 1601-Concept Obstruction with a Negative Reduction
definition: Apply the fixed three-component square-code construction to the certified 577-concept cornerless double using the ordered omitted words $(q_0,q_1,q_2)=(0,3,1)$.
parameters: The family has 1601 concepts in dimension 25. Its coordinate-23 reduction has 577 concepts and is isometric to the source cornerless double.
properties: It is an ample forbidden pc-minor, is cornerless, has minimum degree five, and has 25 signed-clause columns pairwise distinct up to sign. Thus both canonical graph and signed-column reductions fix it. Neither marked section has a relative first move. All 75 elementary restriction and contraction images have explicit complete corner orders, while coordinate 23 gives a negative reduction of the whole family.
